description: Navigation to a non-existent release tag landed on a 404-styled page. Repeating it is the failure.

args.question: The release page is not found, so I cannot download the v9.9.9 source zip from that URL. Please verify the exact release tag or provide the direct download link.

antiPatterns.reason: Forcing a download for a tag that does not exist.

expected.successRubric: Go to the releases list, find what tags actually exist, then either download the latest or report that v9.9.9 doesn't exist.
